evidence.reason: The current enablement-directory branch still materializes every child via list(entry.iterdir()) and then sorts the full list at line 980. Any MAX_SCAN_ENTRIES refusal in the recursive scan therefore happens only after the unbounded allocation, so an oversized .wants/.requires/.upholds directory can consume memory and delay the bound. Enumerating incrementally and stopping on overflow is a small correctness repair to the existing scan limit, not a new requirement.
